outcome: tariff-cost gap (discrepancy between actual costs and national tariffs)
cohort: The study investigated 6126 Global Surgical Procedures (GSPs) performed in three public hospitals in Qazvin Province, Iran.
finding: Public hospitals in Iran experience substantial financial losses because national tariffs for Global Surgical Procedures (GSPs) do not cover their actual costs, with factors like older age, female sex, longer hospital stays, full-time surgeons, and neurosurgery significantly widening this tariff-cost gap.
